y1: After the wise men left, an angel came to Joseph in a dream again: “Get up, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt. Herod is looking for the child to kill him.”
y2: Joseph got up right away and obeyed. That very night, he took Mary and baby Jesus and left.
y4: Joseph's family rode a donkey across the desert to flee to Egypt. It was a very long and hard journey.
y5: They lived in Egypt until Herod died. This made the words of the prophet come true: “I called my son out of Egypt.”
y7: When the wise men didn't come back, Herod got very angry. He gave a very bad order to hurt the little children in Bethlehem.
y8: The mothers in Bethlehem cried a lot. God sees children's tears and is sad with them. God also protected baby Jesus.
y10: After Herod died, the angel came to Joseph's dream again: “Now go back to the land of Israel.”
y11: Joseph's family went to a small village in Galilee called Nazareth and lived there. That is why Jesus was called a “Nazarene.”
verse: “I called my son out of Egypt.”
prayer: Lord God, thank You for protecting me and my family, just as You protected baby Jesus in times of danger. Help me to obey Your word immediately, just like Joseph. Comfort my friends who are sad. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: dream. Something we see when we sleep. God sometimes spoke to people in dreams. An angel appeared to Joseph in a dream.
d1: Egypt. A big country south of Israel. It has the Nile River and pyramids. Joseph's family stayed safe in Egypt.
d2: obey. To listen to what someone says and do it. Joseph obeyed as soon as he woke up from his dream.
d3: flee. To run away from danger and go to a safe place. Joseph's family fled to Egypt in the middle of the night.
d4: prophet. A person who receives a message from God and shares it with people. The words spoken earlier by the prophet Hosea came true.
d5: protect. To keep someone safe from harm or danger. God protected baby Jesus.
d6: Nazareth. A small village in Galilee. Jesus grew up there. People called Jesus “Jesus of Nazareth.”
